name: Akron
note: Torque GC partner; AKRON's own sponsorships page lists Torque GC under 'AKRON Alliances' (akron.com.mx/en/akron-sponsorships, opened 2026-10-03). Private Mexican energy and lubricants group (LinkedIn: privately held); its predecessor Mexicana de Lubricantes (Mexlub) was reported majority-held by Salvador Martinez Garza (El Economista, 2009), who died in 2018. Current owner not confirmed in named press, so the sponsor stays unrated.
